display.name: PSV RSI-2 Pullback
display.description:
rsi(2) on 5m eth. under 10 we buy the pullback, over 90 we sell it, and between those we hold no directional position and just quote the spread.

the profit-share version: no promised interest. depositors buy shares, and their value floats with the strategy's pnl. the manager takes a 15% carry on profit when shares are withdrawn, plus a 1.5%/yr management fee that accrues continuously. buy while the share price is low and you get more shares.
